messages:
Nadia Lopez: Quick thread to finalize the "eval artifact contract" + rollout hooks for catalog onboards. We need one canonical machine-readable output infra, legal, and sales can rely on.

Ravi Patel: 👍 Outline please. We want deterministic auto-blocks and a tenant-aware rollback path.

Nadia Lopez: Draft artifact fields: model, version, run_ts, baseline_id, slices: list of slice names, quality_deltas: list of numbers (aligned to slices), regression_budget_pctpoints, lat_ms: {p50,p95,p99}, cost_delta_pct, schema_hash, embed_schema_version, golden_queries_hash, smoke_ok (bool), privacy_review_ref, kms_key, canary_signature. Artifact location: s3://redwood-evals/{model}/{version}/{run_ts}/artifact-v2.json

Sophie Tran: Please keep slices small and named consistently. For quality_deltas prefer absolute percentage points, e.g., 0.8 means 0.8 percentage points worse. Add a "blocking_reasons" array to list pass/fail triggers for transparency.

Nadia Lopez: Good call. Adding blocking_reasons. Also propose a "tolerance_profile" key: sets per-slice allowed regression and p95 latency thresholds. Example: {"intent": {"regression_budget":1.0, "p95_ms":300}}

Marco Diaz: For embed consumers we must include "embed_schema_version" and a "vector_compat_score" (0-100). Block if <85 for production tenants. Also include sample_embedding_hashes for a deterministic smoke check.

Ravi Patel: Rollout knobs: tenant-level soft-pin window: 10-14 days for paid tenants, 3 days for self-serve. Canary size: default 3% or 10k requests, whichever hits first, run for 7 days. Auto-fallback triggers: anomaly_rate >0.5% sustained 10m OR p95 latency increase >35% vs baseline for 10m.

Sophie Tran: Add manual pause and emergency-revert APIs: /rollouts/{id}/pause, /rollouts/{id}/revert with audit_reason. Ops needs an audit trail id returned by artifact.

Nadia Lopez: We'll surface artifact.path and artifact.audit_id in the rollout controller. Infra can call InspectArtifact(path) to derive blocking_reasons.

ops-bot: CI: running benchmark for model "orchid-alpha-1" job=bmk-2026-04-02-09 ETA=2h.

Marco Diaz: Legal/compliance: EEA tenants require "data_processing_approved": true and kms_key present or block. Add "dpa_reference" and "data residency" fields.

Ravi Patel: Where do we store golden queries and expected hashes? They should be in the same s3 folder but separate file golden-queries.json with arrays of {id, query_hash, expected_output_hash}.

Sophie Tran: For infra rule engine we will implement simple rules: fail if any quality_delta > regression_budget for that slice OR any latency p95 > tolerance_profile[slice].p95_ms OR cost_delta_pct > +20 OR vector_compat_score < tenant_min. We'll surface blocking_reasons back to the UI.

Nadia Lopez: Timeline: I'll post a short spec doc with artifact JSON schema + example files by EOD Thursday, infra will prototype rule engine this sprint, legal to confirm DPA checklist within 7 business days. Final note: keep the artifact backwards-compatible; use artifact_version key.

Ravi Patel: LGTM. Tagging infra and legal for follow-ups.

Marco Diaz: Also propose a post-rollout survey metric for early customers: quality_ok boolean plus freeform notes. We'll include survey_id in artifact during soft-pin phase.

Nadia Lopez: Nice. Done. I'll publish the doc and circle back with infra/ops links. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
